description: Source code implementing IPC (Inter-Process Communication) for Intel ADSP within Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, message handling, ISR, and power management.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_set_message_handler
methods.description: Sets the message handler callback for IPC.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_set_done_handler
methods.description: Sets the done notification callback for IPC.

methods.name: z_intel_adsp_ipc_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling IPC interrupts.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPC device, sets up registers and interrupts.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_complete
methods.description: Marks IPC as complete by updating registers.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_is_complete
methods.description: Checks if IPC transfer is complete.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_send_message_sync
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for completion.

methods.name: intel_adsp_ipc_send_message_emergency
methods.description: Emergency message send bypassing normal flow.
